Same defect as images-without-default: a document counted as an image. Restricted to image file extensions.

Read only the product stock figure; stock kept per location does not roll up into it. A stock unit of the same product and variant above zero now counts.

checkCorrections.note: Revision 7: counted ProductNumber LIKE TCPROD%, but TCPROD is the sample-data product id prefix (the numbers are TC-<concept>-nnnn), so a correct site FAILed. Now counts distinct ProductId values that start TCPROD.

Revision 7: the sample data ships two AccessUser rows under the user name TruvioBuyer (AccessUserIsLogin 1 and 0), so SQL counted 2 where MCP counted 1. The SQL read now counts the login row only, the scope the MCP read returned.

Revision 7: the function claims a GTIN for every product that is traded. The share counted masters and simple products and left variants out, so a variant catalogue whose variants carry the GTIN read low. It now counts simple products and variants and exempts a master with variant groups, the population pim.identifiers.number-missing already uses.

Revision 7: offender checks whose claim needs subjects state minimumSubjects 1 and count their subjects with subjectsQuery. Zero offenders over zero subjects (for example no completed orders) is FAIL, no longer PASS.
Revision 7: intent.proves stated the template text "... satisfies the selected profile assertion". Each now states what its query proves. No query or assertion changed by this record.

Revision 7 (issue #223): grounds that say another function carries the need name it in requiresFunction; the ruling holds only while every locked check of that function passes. 28 grounds, for example commerce.discounts-v2 classic-discounts -> commerce.discounts.

Revision 7: requirement ids that were descriptions (a storage key, a package or a tenant registration nobody had measured) can never match a fact, so every check of these functions stayed UNVERIFIED. They are removed; the precondition stays in the description.
